description: Implement the chat system (apps.chat), the private admin dashboard (apps.dashboard), all templates and static assets. This is the final backend+frontend layer. Depends on FEAT-001 (models) and FEAT-002 (URL namespaces must be wired in config/urls.py). The chat uses polling — no WebSockets. The dashboard uses Django's built-in auth (login_required) — not a new auth system.
steps: 1. Create apps/chat/forms.py: StartConversationForm(customer_name, customer_email required, customer_phone optional, initial_message TextField max_length=2000); MessageForm(content TextField max_length=2000 with strip=True). Both validate that content is not blank after stripping.

2. Create apps/chat/views.py: ChatStartView (GET shows form; POST creates Conversation with session_key=request.session.session_key ensuring session exists, stores conversation_id in session, redirects to chat window); ChatWindowView (get Conversation by pk+session_key match — 403 if mismatch; mark messages as read; context includes all messages and MessageForm); SendMessageView (POST-only AJAX, creates Message with is_from_dj=False, validates length, returns JSON {id, content, timestamp, is_from_dj}); PollMessagesView (GET AJAX, accepts ?since= timestamp ISO format, returns new messages as JSON array — used for polling). Rate limit SendMessageView: max 20 messages per conversation per hour using a simple counter stored in the Message table.

3. Create apps/chat/urls.py with namespace='chat': path('chat/', ChatStartView, name='start'), path('chat/<int:pk>/', ChatWindowView, name='window'), path('chat/<int:pk>/send/', SendMessageView, name='send'), path('chat/<int:pk>/poll/', PollMessagesView, name='poll'). Add to config/urls.py.

4. Create apps/dashboard/views.py with login_required on every view (decorator, not mixin, for clarity): DashboardHomeView (counts: bookings today, pending bookings, unread messages, total plays); BookingListView (filterable by status, date range, search by name/email); BookingDetailView (shows all booking info, quotation form, status update form, internal notes form, booking history); QuotationCreateUpdateView (create or update Quotation for a booking); BookingStatusUpdateView (POST, creates BookingStatusHistory entry, updates Booking.status, generates WhatsApp link for customer notification); ContactMessageListView (mark read); GalleryManageView and GalleryUploadView; MusicManageView; VideoManageView; ChatAdminListView (list all conversations, unread count); ChatAdminReplyView (GET shows conversation with reply form; POST creates Message with is_from_dj=True, marks all customer messages as read).

5. Create apps/dashboard/forms.py: QuotationForm(amount, currency, details, terms, expires_at optional); BookingStatusForm(status Select from BOOKING_STATUSES, note TextField); InternalNoteForm(internal_notes); GalleryImageForm(title, description, image CloudinaryField, category, is_published, is_featured, order); MixForm, TrackForm, VideoForm for upload/edit.

6. Create apps/dashboard/urls.py with namespace='dashboard', all paths under 'dashboard/': path('', DashboardHomeView, name='home'), path('bookings/', BookingListView, name='bookings'), path('bookings/<uuid:reference>/', BookingDetailView, name='booking_detail'), path('bookings/<uuid:reference>/quotation/', QuotationCreateUpdateView, name='quotation'), path('bookings/<uuid:reference>/status/', BookingStatusUpdateView, name='booking_status'), path('messages/', ContactMessageListView, name='messages'), path('gallery/', GalleryManageView, name='gallery'), path('gallery/upload/', GalleryUploadView, name='gallery_upload'), path('gallery/<int:pk>/delete/', GalleryDeleteView, name='gallery_delete'), path('music/', MusicManageView, name='music'), path('music/mix/add/', MixAddView, name='mix_add'), path('music/mix/<slug:slug>/edit/', MixEditView, name='mix_edit'), path('music/track/add/', TrackAddView, name='track_add'), path('videos/', VideoManageView, name='videos'), path('videos/add/', VideoAddView, name='video_add'), path('chat/', ChatAdminListView, name='chat'), path('chat/<int:pk>/', ChatAdminReplyView, name='chat_reply'), path('site-settings/', SiteSettingsView, name='site_settings'). Add login_required to all. Add path('accounts/login/', ...) from django.contrib.auth.views. Add to config/urls.py.

7. Create the base template at templates/base.html: dark-themed HTML5 shell with CSS custom properties (--bg-primary: #0a0a0a, --bg-secondary: #111111, --bg-card: #1a1a1a, --accent: #c9a84c, --accent-dark: #a0843d, --text-primary: #f5f5f5, --text-muted: #888), responsive nav with hamburger mobile menu, footer with social links from site_settings context processor, Django messages block, {% block content %} main area, links to /static/css/main.css and /static/js/main.js.

8. Create templates/core/home.html, templates/core/about.html, templates/core/contact.html, templates/core/contact_success.html — all extend base.html. Home: hero section with DJ name and CTA buttons, featured mixes section (cards with cover art and play button), featured tracks, featured videos grid, gallery strip, booking CTA banner, WhatsApp float button. About: biography text, profile image. Contact: form with CSRF, success/error messages. All sections show polished empty states when querysets are empty.

9. Create templates/music/mix_list.html, templates/music/mix_detail.html, templates/music/track_list.html, templates/music/track_detail.html. Mix detail and track detail pages embed an HTML5 audio player that streams from Cloudinary URL. The player includes: play/pause button, seekable progress bar (input[type=range]), current time and total duration, volume slider, keyboard shortcuts (Space=play/pause). Use vanilla JS — no external audio library.
10. Create templates/videos/list.html, templates/videos/detail.html. Video detail embeds HTML5 video element with Cloudinary src. Video list shows thumbnail grid with category filter tabs.

11. Create templates/gallery/index.html (responsive CSS Grid, lightbox using vanilla JS — click image to open full-size overlay, Escape to close, arrow keys to navigate), templates/gallery/detail.html.

12. Create templates/bookings/create.html (multi-field booking form with clear labels and validation error display), templates/bookings/success.html (show tracking link prominently with copy button JS), templates/bookings/tracking.html (status timeline, quotation display when present, accept/decline buttons when status=quotation_sent), templates/bookings/quotation_responded.html.

13. Create templates/chat/start.html (intro form), templates/chat/window.html (message thread, send form, JS polling every 3 seconds using fetch to /chat/<pk>/poll/?since=<lastTimestamp>). Polling JS: on each response append new messages to the thread, scroll to bottom, update lastTimestamp.

14. Create templates/dashboard/ templates: base_dashboard.html (extends base.html, adds sidebar nav), home.html (stats cards), bookings_list.html (filterable table), booking_detail.html (full booking management page with all forms), messages_list.html, gallery_manage.html, music_manage.html, videos_manage.html, chat_list.html, chat_reply.html, site_settings.html. Dashboard uses a sidebar with icon links. All forms show CSRF tokens.
15. Create templates/registration/login.html — styled login page extending base.html. Create templates/errors/404.html and templates/errors/500.html — on-brand error pages.

16. Create static/css/main.css: CSS custom properties, dark background, typography (system font stack or Google Fonts loaded via <link>), responsive grid utilities, nav styles, card styles, form styles, audio player styles, gallery lightbox styles, booking status timeline styles, chat window styles, dashboard sidebar styles, button variants (.btn-primary with gold accent, .btn-outline), mobile breakpoints at 768px and 480px.

17. Create static/js/main.js: mobile nav toggle, audio player logic (attach to <audio> elements, update progress bar on timeupdate, seek on range input change), gallery lightbox (open/close/navigate), chat polling (exported as startChatPolling(conversationPk) called from the chat window template), copy-to-clipboard for tracking link, smooth scroll for anchor links.

18. Create apps/chat/tests.py: test conversation creation, test message send via POST returns JSON, test poll endpoint returns only messages after given timestamp, test wrong session_key gets 403. Create apps/dashboard/tests.py: test unauthenticated access to dashboard redirects to login, test authenticated staff user can access dashboard home, test booking status update creates BookingStatusHistory entry.

19. Add MEDIA_URL = '/media/' and MEDIA_ROOT = BASE_DIR / 'media' to config/settings.py (for local dev fallback). Add STATICFILES_DIRS = [BASE_DIR / 'static'] to config/settings.py. Add path for serving media in dev to config/urls.py (wrapped in settings.DEBUG check using static()).

20. Create apps/bookings/utils.py with a generate_whatsapp_link(phone, message) function that URL-encodes the message and returns https://wa.me/<phone>?text=<encoded>. Used in booking status update and tracking page.
acceptance_criteria: python manage.py test apps --verbosity=2 passes all tests
GET / returns 200 with rendered HTML (not empty)
POST /chat/ with valid data creates Conversation and redirects to chat window
GET /dashboard/ redirects to login for anonymous user
Static files load: /static/css/main.css returns 200 after collectstatic
